snippet.title: Ascension - The Immortal Alchemist - Intro Trailer HD
snippet.description:
Ascension: The Immortal Alchemist is a competitive action platformer and escape-room speed runner inspired by the mystery cults of Ancient Egypt and Greece.

Descend into the Astral Labyrinth, endure the Trials of the Immortal Alchemist, and uncover the forbidden secrets hidden within the darkest recesses of your soul.

Challenge your mind. Test your reflexes. Ascend beyond the illusion.

Available on Steam VERY SOON! 

Wishlist Now:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2958900/Ascension_The_Immortal_Alchemist/
